Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-center lane on a city street in League City, Texas, when Driver 2 attempted to change
lanes from the adjacent lane and made contact with the left rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. The sideswipe left
a clear scrape pattern along the body panels on both vehicles, and the damage observed on scene is consistent with
the impact as described by both drivers. Two independent witnesses stood near the intersection and told me the
collision occurred as Driver 2 merged, and photographs taken at the scene show the same contact points. Driver 1
reported neck and back strain and said the force of the impact pushed the body forward and then back against the
seat. Driver 1's account of the collision remained consistent throughout our conversation, and Driver 2 did not dispute
the sequence of events. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. Passenger was also in the vehicle and
reported no injury at the scene. Our observations found no sign of prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle in the affected
areas. Driver 1 was unsure at one point exactly which seat position they occupied during impact, though they were
certain they were seated behind the steering wheel.
